title: WildLive Public AI Development Archive — session metadata
description: One metadata document per archived AI development session. Fields that cannot be known until after merge (pr_number, pr_url, merge_commit, ci_status, post_merge_ci_status) are nullable; leaving them null is preferable to guessing.

task.description: Human-readable label, e.g. 'Task 005'. Must match the milestone report numbering, not the PR number.

agent.description: The AI agent that performed the session, e.g. 'Claude Code (claude-opus-4-7[1m])'.

source_language.description: The language the interaction actually happened in.

published_language.description: The language the archived record is published in. Always English per the current policy.

translation_policy.description: Human-readable statement of the translation rules used, e.g. 'Faithful English translation of the original Japanese prompt and visible AI interaction. No summary, beautification, or added requirements.'

human_directed.description: true when the session was driven by an explicit human prompt (the normal case). false only for automation-only sessions with no human trigger.

prompt_path.description: Relative to the task directory. Always 'prompt.en.md' in the current layout.

transcript_path.description: Relative to the task directory. Always 'transcript.en.md' in the current layout.

base_commit.description: The commit on `main` this branch was created from.

ci_status.description: Conclusion of the PR's CI run before merge.

post_merge_ci_status.description: Conclusion of the CI run on main after the merge commit.

report_en.description: Path to the English development report, relative to repository root.

report_ja.description: Path to the Japanese development report, relative to repository root.

x_manifest.description: Path to the X Development Live manifest for this task, relative to repository root. May be null when the task explicitly ships without one.

notes.description: Optional free-form note. Do not use to smuggle in requirements or unverifiable claims.
